blocks.text: CEBU CITY — The Cebu City Police Office (CCPO) assured it has launched a comprehensive investigation following the discovery of a dead man who had been buried in cement and charcoal in Barangay Pahina Central. A team of investigators has been deployed to lead the inquiry. Authorities assured the public that all available resources are being used to uncover the circumstances and hold those responsible accountable. Both Cebu City Mayor Nestor Archival and Councilor Pablo “Paul” Labra II have called for a swift investigation.
